title: A Border for the Cover Revisited
author: Sable Nakamura
blurb: Oscar Villalobos, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
